market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at $99.32 (Apr 29). 52-week high is only $117.63 (likely Q1 2026 peak when Brent hit $118). Hitting $140 needs ~41% rise from spot in 2 months. Even with Strait of Hormuz disruption, EIA expects Brent (higher than WTI) to peak only at $115 in Q2 2026.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail risk of major escalation cutting off Persian Gulf flows entirely
